hillburrow/sabotage.title: A Bang-Up Investigation
hillburrow/sabotage.description: Somepony has been sabotaging Hillburrow's coal mine: a string of unexplained explosions has been wrecking equipment and killing slaves. Bitty Potiok, who runs the mine, wants it to stop, and she wants you to find out who's responsible.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-gotPointersFromBitty: Bitty Potiok suggested you talk to Apathy Flake, the mercenary chief who'd been looking into the explosions before you got involved.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-gotMotivesFromBitty: According to Bitty, plenty of ponies could want to see the mine fail: her own brother Rewan, the original inhabitants of Hillburrow, or simply anyone holding a grudge against the Potiok family.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-talkedToMercenaryBoss: You spoke with Apathy Flake about his own investigation into the sabotage.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-foundWaterCarrierDynamite: While poking around the water carrier's shack, you found stacks of dynamite, the same kind used to blow up the mine's equipment.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-waterCarrierConfessed: You gathered enough to be sure of it: the water carrier was behind the explosions.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-figuredOutExplosives: You pieced together how the dynamite was being smuggled in and set up around the mine.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-learnedAboutTiming: You figured out when the saboteur usually strikes, which should make it easier to catch them in the act.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-discoveredBibinInvolvement: It turned out the water carrier wasn't acting alone: he'd been taking orders from Bibin, a small-time gangster from the Cristal Den slums with a grudge against the Potioks.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-waterCarrierTakenToBoss: You brought the water carrier before Bitty Potiok, so she could deal with him personally.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-foughtWaterCarrier: Things turned violent: the water carrier wasn't willing to come quietly, and you had to fight him off.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-sentByMatriarch: You came to Hillburrow on behalf of the Potiok Matriarch herself, tasked with looking into why the mine's output had dropped.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-warnedPotioksAboutBibin: You made sure the Potioks were warned that Bibin and his people were behind the attacks.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-reportedFindingsToBitty: You reported everything you'd found back to Bitty Potiok, closing the case on the mine's saboteur.
hillburrow/sabotage.desc-killedBittyPotiok: Bitty Potiok is dead. Whatever happened to her, she never got to hear what you'd found out, and the investigation died with her.
hillburrow/sabotage.findCulprit: Find out who's sabotaging the mine
hillburrow/sabotage.confession: Get to the bottom of the water carrier's involvement
